name: Titanium.UI.iOS.StatusBar
summary: A set of constants for the status bar style.

properties.name: ANIMATION_STYLE_FADE
properties.summary: Fade animation style, when the status bar is hidden or shown.
properties.description:
One of the group of status bar animation style constants
[ANIMATION_STYLE_NONE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.StatusBar#ANIMATION_STYLE_NONE), 
[ANIMATION_STYLE_SLIDE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.StatusBar#ANIMATION_STYLE_SLIDE), 
and [ANIMATION_STYLE_FADE](api:Titanium.UI.iOS.StatusBar#ANIMATION_STYLE_FADE).
